sloka: अग्रतः प्रययुस् तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रि पुरोधसः ।अधिरुह्य हयैः युक्तान् रथान् सूर्य रथ उपमान् ॥२-८३-२॥
transliteration: agrataḥ prayayus tasya sarve mantri purodhasaḥ ।adhiruhya hayaiḥ yuktān rathān sūrya ratha upamān ॥2-83-2॥

translations.english: All the ministers and priests went ahead of Bharata mounting their chariots, harnessed with horses and resembling the chariot of the Sun god.
